notes: ZOMBIES IS NOW PLAYED ON BLACKWELL HOSPITAL. You start in the south lobby and the ambulance bay.

BUY DOORS: 20 boarded doors and barricades (750 to 1500 points) open the hospital bit by bit - the main corridor, the yards, the north wing, the atrium, the stairwells, the bridge and the ward doors on both floors. Zombies only come from the parts you have opened. In co-op a door anyone buys opens for the whole squad.
GUN UPGRADER: find the glowing machine in the north wing. 5000 points upgrades the gun in your hands: double damage, a bigger magazine, twice the reserve ammo and a purple glow.

BLACKWELL HOSPITAL is now bloody and gross: blood pools, drag trails, handprints and writing on the walls, mould, water stains, body bags, blood-soaked beds, fallen ceiling tiles and flickering lights.
